base.meaning: the editor and terminal background; the darkest thing on screen

surface.meaning: panels on base: sidebars, statusline, tab bar, inactive splits, cursor line

overlay.meaning: things that float or are chosen: popups, menus, floating windows, selection, string highlight

border.meaning: lines, not areas: split separators, float borders, indent guides

muted.meaning: text that recedes: comments, line numbers, operators, punctuation, hints

subtle.meaning: text that supports: keywords, decorators, builtin literals, secondary ui, info

text.meaning: text that carries meaning: identifiers, properties, numbers, strings, ui default

bright.meaning: text that names a shape: types, classes, jsx tags; the lightest step

accent.meaning: the lime, invariant. a point, never an area: cursor, prompt char, active indicator, search fill, matching bracket, function names

accent-quiet.meaning: the lime desaturated: diff added, links, git-new

error.meaning: red: errors, diff deleted, failed tests; the loudest colour permitted

warning.meaning: amber: warnings, diff changed, git modified

blue-tint.meaning: ansi 4: a grey leaning blue, so terminal programs keep their categories
